Request model for creating or updating a bare identity (gid_identitet only).

code history (skh_kodehistorikk) or IdentityServer registration.

userAccessFunctions, userRoles) are intentionally excluded because identities
with kategoriid 2 or 3 never have a sbr_bruker row.

get.description:
Lists active access group memberships for a user.

Query parameter `internal` controls filtering on `Ntg_Generell`:

- `internal=true` => only internal groups (`Ntg_Generell = 0`)

- `internal=false` => only non-internal groups (`Ntg_Generell = 1`)

- missing `internal` => all active memberships

- invalid `internal` value => fallback to non-internal groups (`Ntg_Generell = 1`)

            
Examples:
`/api/users/123/AccessGroupMembership?lookupField=gidid`
`/api/users/123/AccessGroupMembership?lookupField=gidid&internal=true`
`/api/users/123/AccessGroupMembership?lookupField=gidid&internal=false`
`/api/users/123/AccessGroupMembership?lookupField=gidid&internal=abc`

parameters.description: User identifier value for lookupField (lookupField=Id uses GID id (gid_gidid) or login (Gid_Loginn)).
parameters.name: id

parameters.description: Lookup field. Field to use when finding user. Possible values: Id (default), gidid and Code.
parameters.name: lookupField

parameters.description: Optional filter for internal groups. true returns only internal (Ntg_Generell=0), false returns only non-internal (Ntg_Generell=1). Missing value returns all active memberships. Invalid values fall back to non-internal.
parameters.name: internal
